events.comment: The content (chapters, archangels, shadow-thoughts, gifts…) comes from assets/data/content.json, built by tools/build-content.mjs. The save lives in the browser storage and is merged over the defaults of the global variable Save.
The chapter is done: light joins the lifetime total (ranks), manna is given (more the first time), the tool is kept in the toolbox, an archangel may join.
Page 1: the thought record and three answers (shuffled: Run.order). Page 2: the truth. Page 3: the tool. Page 4: the report. Page 5: the finale, once, after the last chapter.
Not chosen yet: the answer and a button. Chosen: what kind of answer it is and why, in its place.

events.comment: Page 2: the lie is crossed out, then the truth appears.
Buttons and keys: a click or a key first shows everything at once, then moves on.
Cyclic sighing: in through the nose (4 s), a short second sip (1 s), a long slow breath out (8 s); six rounds. Exhale-focused breathing has moderate evidence for lowering stress (Balban 2023).
